notes: Only workflow conclusions and head SHAs are claimed; per-job pass counts were not transcribed from the CI logs.
CI installs from pyproject.toml without constraints.txt by design: the snapshot was resolved on Windows and forcing it on a Linux runner would turn platform differences into build failures.
A green CI run therefore confirms the code change, not the pinned combination; the combination evidence is the local dry run plus the install onto the stage 48 clean-room venv.
The sqlglot 30.27.0 attempt was rolled back before either commit, so no CI run covers it; its evidence is the local 350-failure run recorded in stage-49.md.
